notes.recognition: Wind-combed ochre ground and embedded glass read immediately as desert terrain.
notes.agency: Flowing currents imply traversal direction without baking in a playable route.
notes.specificity: Amber glass fragments and charcoal mineral grit make the surface world-specific.
notes.restraint: The broad sand field remains quieter than the raised rocks and player pawns.
notes.continuity: Warm agency color stays material-local and never becomes full-frame neon.
notes.reusability: The non-directional crop works across rotations and differently shaped tile clusters.
notes.accessibility: Ripple relief and mineral fragments remain readable in grayscale.
